Channel Info

MSXAUDIO_USE_CHANNEL need to be set to TRUE to use functions from this group

MSXAudio_GetChannelCount
u8 MSXAudio_GetChannelCount()
View source

Get the number of MSX-Audio channels: 9 FM channels (or 6 FM channels and 5 rhythm instruments in rhythm mode) and the ADPCM channel

Return

Number of channels (10 or 12)

MSXAudio_GetChannelVolume
u8 MSXAudio_GetChannelVolume(
u8 
chan
)
View source

Get the current volume of a given channel (carrier operator level, based on the values written with MSXAudio_SetRegister)

Parameters
chan
u8

Channel index (0 to 8 for FM channels; in rhythm mode, 0 to 5 for FM channels and 6 to 10 for bass drum, snare drum, tom-tom, top cymbal and high hat). The last channel is the ADPCM

Return

Volume from 0 (mute) to 15 (max). 0 if the channel (or rhythm instrument) is not keyed on, or if the ADPCM is not playing

MSXAudio_GetChannelType
u8 MSXAudio_GetChannelType(
u8 
chan
)
View source

Get the type of a given channel

Parameters
chan
u8

Channel index (same as MSXAudio_GetChannelVolume)

Return

CHANNEL_TYPE_SAMPLE for the ADPCM (last channel), CHANNEL_TYPE_FM_RHYTHM for rhythm instruments (6 to 10 in rhythm mode), CHANNEL_TYPE_FM_INST otherwise
